subject: Quick project catch-up and a snag on Thursday
text: Hi Professor, I hope things have gone smoothly since we last chatted, and that the semester has not swallowed your weekends whole. I am still tinkering with the project materials you handed me through the student group, and as a family friend I wanted to give you a heads-up before you open the shared drive on Friday. The literature notes are mostly cleaned up, the interview summaries are tagged by theme, and I have started a tidy spreadsheet for the citations so nobody has to rebuild the references at midnight. That part is moving along nicely, thank goodness. The snag is that I have a family commitment the same evening I had penciled in for the data-cleanup sprint, and I cannot wiggle out of it this time, especially because it is a rare chance to help out at home. I do not want this to turn into a mess on your desk, so I have shifted my work earlier in the day and will send you whatever is polished by late afternoon. If there is a smaller piece you would prefer I tackle first, just let me know, even a rough note is fine. I will keep the changes easy to spot and make sure the folder remains uncluttered for anyone else using it. I appreciate your patience, and I promise not to let the details get away from me. Thanks again for trusting me with this part of the work, and I will have an update ready for you soon.
